# 5/3/1 Routine - YYYY-MM-DD

Use this as the output shape for a generated four-week routine. Replace all placeholder text with concrete prescriptions, exact accessory sets and reps, and explicit superset pairings. Normal weeks use two paired supersets (Superset A and Superset B). Deload week uses only one paired superset.

## Summary

### Sync Naming

- Folder Name: 5/3/1 - YYYY-MM-DD Block
- Routine Title Format: W[week]D[day]: [Main Lift Short]
- Short Lift Labels: Squat, Deadlift, Bench, OHP

### Routine Overview

| Week | Day | Main Lift | Accessory 1a | Accessory 1b | Accessory 2a | Accessory 2b |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [week] | [day] | [main lift label] | [accessory 1a] | [accessory 1b] | [accessory 2a] | [accessory 2b] |

### Muscle Group Frequency

| Muscle Group | Days Worked | Total Exposures |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [group] | [count] | [count] |

Use the same column order as structure.csv for the overview table.
Count muscle-group frequency using direct programmed work in the routine.
Use these summary groups: Back, Shoulders, Chest, Legs, Core, Arms.
Use the routine date in the title as the block date for the sync naming section.
